fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Personal Identity Declaration Form You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. One Recommendation Letter with school seal or signature of the referee. 3. English Language Proficiency Certificate For Bilingual program * 4. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . 6. Videos 7. CV * 8. Personal Statement written in the Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . 9. Portfolio * 10. Scanned PDFs of the International Undergraduate Admission Program Application Guarantee The guarantee letter must be signed by the guarantor. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. International Undergraduate Admission Program Letter of Commitment Application The commitment letter must be completed and signed by the applican. You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. HSK Certificate and scanned copy of original transcript. (Except for the Chinese Language & Literature major) * 13. Scanned copy of passport information page; Scanned copy of visa or residential permit for students already studying in China. * 14. Electronic photo with white background (minimum size: 640dpi*480dpi) * 15. Academic transcript in Chinese or English Notarized translated version is required if the original document is not in Chinese or English. (Original documents need to be offered for check on registration day) * 16. Scanned copies of diploma of highest education in Chinese or English. If you are a new graduate who do not have a degree certificate at the moment, you can submit the transcripts first, and the degree certificate will be audited at the enrollment. Notarized translated version is required if the original document is not in Chinese or English. (Original documents need to be offered for check on registration day) * 17. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements: Applicants should, in principle, be between 18 and 25 years of age (calculated as of September 1, 2008), in good physical and mental health(free from infectious diseases and from any physical or mental conditions that would affect normal study) , with a high school diploma, or have an equivalent qualification of a Chinese high school diploma and above stages (As of September 1, 2026, the applicant must have obtained a high school diploma).They must demonstrate excellent academic performance and conduct, comply with the relevant provisions of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, hold a valid foreign passport, and be non-Chinese citizens who are friendly toward China and have no criminal record. 2. Nationality Determination: According to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and the regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (Jiaowaihan [2020] No. 12), individuals whose parents are both Chinese citizens or one of whom is a Chinese citizen and who have settled abroad, and who acquired foreign nationality at birth, are not considered Chinese nationals. As foreign student applicants, such individuals must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certification before April 30, 2022, and must have a record of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (a stay of nine months in a foreign country within a year is considered equivalent to a full year, based on entry and exit stamps). 3. Special Residency Cases:In accordance with the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, residents of Mainland China, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Macao Special Administrative Region, and Taiwan who have immigrated and acquired foreign nationality must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certification beforeApril 30, 2022,and have a certificate of having canceled Chinese nationality, and must have a record of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (a stay of nine months in a foreign country within a year is considered equivalent to a full year, based on entry and exit stamps). Notes: Whether an applicant who holds foreign nationality also holds the nationality of the People’s Republic of China shall be determined based on the nationality determination issued by the Exit and Entry Administration of the Chinese public security authorities. If the applicant is found to hold Chinese nationality during the application process, admission process, or after enrollment, their application eligibility, admission eligibility, or enrollment status shall be revoked, or corresponding measures shall be taken. 4. [Language Proficiency]HSK Level 5 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section; HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above, with a minimum score of 60 (all results must be within the validity period). Notes: For programs offered by the School of Broadcasting and Anchoring, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Advanced level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For programs offered by the School of International Studies, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Advanced level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For the major of Network and New Media (Operation of Intelligent Media Convergence) applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 6 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. For the major of Chinese Language and Literature, applicants are required to have Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 4 or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60 in each section, and HSKK (Speaking) Intermediate level or above (inclusive), with a minimum score of 60. Malaysian high school graduates from Chinese independent schools can submit their UEC exam results. Applicants with passing grades in Chinese are exempt from submitting HSK certificates. Other Malaysian applicants must meet the HSK language proficiency requirements outlined above. For applicants whose native language is not English, relevant English proficiency certificates or test results may be submitted as supplementary materials. If oral test results are already included on the HSK score report, submission of a separate HSKK score report is not required. 5.
